# IVD nucleus pulposus degeneration (fabricated claims)

Bulk RNA-seq of intervertebral disc nucleus pulposus cells revealed transcriptional signatures of degeneration. FOXF1 was downregulated in degenerated versus healthy specimens (Table 4). PAX1 was downregulated with log2FC of -5.2 in the NP cells (Table 4). KRT18 was downregulated (Table 4).

SOX9 was downregulated in the degenerated condition (Table 4). ACAN was upregulated as a marker of healthy NP phenotype (Table 4). COL2A1 was strongly upregulated (Table 4).

MMP13 was downregulated, inconsistent with increased matrix remodeling (Table 4). ADAMTS4 was downregulated (Table 4). TNF was upregulated as expected in the inflammatory context (Table 4). IL6 was upregulated (Table 4).
